recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Reopen core source work only if FHIR core again owns generated HL7 v2 table pages; otherwise route current V2 table translation/comment rendering requests to THO/UTG.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core issue requesting that translated comments for HL7 v2 tables render in HTML, using v2 table 0292 Vaccines Administered as the example where comments carried full names for abbreviated displays.
initial_application: Git-svn commit 95d5a763f7bb761021e245cff9b41e1572764531, '#8910 - significant upgrade of language support on code systems', matches the Jira comment for svn revision 12683. It added language-tab support and translated code-system comment rendering behavior; the retained legacy v2 source still contains translated comment data for table 0292.
additional_context: The old source/v2 page tree is absent, active core source files and source/fhir.ini do not reference tools/tx/v2 as a current generated page input, and the former build.fhir.org v2/0292 and CodeSystem-v2-0292 core URLs return 404. Current core terminology guidance points to THO, where V2 0292/CVX is published as retired/not represented with a pointer to current CVX content.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No core source was changed because the historical fix is already represented and any remaining current presentation issue for V2 table comments belongs in the HL7 Terminology/UTG publication stack rather than HL7/fhir core.
